There are 2 free seats still available in the CS3E1 Machine Learning elective [SQL]. 

Here are the details for the course:
* **Course Code & Title:** CS3E1 Machine Learning [SQL]
* **Free Seats:** 2 [SQL]
sql: SELECT c.course_code, c.title, (c.capacity - COUNT(e.enrollment_id)) AS free_seats FROM courses AS c LEFT JOIN enrollments AS e ON c.course_id = e.course_id AND e.status = 'enrolled' WHERE c.course_code = 'CS3E1' GROUP BY c.course_code, c.title, c.capacity LIMIT 200
